newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - INDONESIAN NEWSPAPERS - AUGUST 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - INDONESIAN NEWSPAPERS - AUGUST 12.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on August 11. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

The Council of Ulamas (MUI) should be more straightforward in telling the truth, Minister of Information Hartono said at a meeting in Jakarta. He added that the MUI represents the people and should therefore always tell the people if there's anything that could harm them.
Share prices on the Jakarta Stock Exchange tumbled by 2.6 percent as the rupiah weakened to 2,6612/2,620 against the dollar due to spillover from the drop in the ringgit.

President Suharto's eldest daughter and member of the Indonesian Association of Islamic Intellectuals (ICMI), Siti Hardianti Rukmana (Mbak Tutut) said having more people entering ICMI was good for the spread of Islam. "Joining ICMI is good. If there are different opinions on this then where do these opinions come from?"
Economist Mohamed Sadli says he thinks the government will allow the rupiah to depreciate by seven percent to the U.S. dollar this year as long as other ASEAN currencies are plunging.

The social and political affairs director-general of the Home Affairs Ministry said there is no need for a dialogue between the two factions of the Indonesian Democratic Party (PDI). "PDI is only one, not two or three," he said.
